title: Mexico's Sinaloa war
current_phase: The Chapitos and the Mayiza have fought for control of the Sinaloa Cartel since September 2024.

history.text: El Mayo Zambada was flown to the US in July 2024, and fighting between the two factions began that September.

turning_points.text: El Mayo Zambada is flown to the US.

what.text: ACLED describes the war between the Chapitos and the Mayiza, now in its second year, as having spread beyond Culiacán.
El País reported in October 2026 that the violence had intensified in Mazatlán and the sierra.

log.text: Federal and state forces arrested El Isra, a Los Rusos operator for the Mayiza, in Mexicali.
